WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM races
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.circuitId,
    rc.race_count,
    CAST(rc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total AS share
  FROM race_counts rc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    s.circuitId,
    s.race_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - a.avg_share AS excess
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN average_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rn
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  race_count,
  share,
  excess
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10 
   OR excess = (SELECT excess FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10)
ORDER BY excess DESC
